homeSubtitle: Here is today's weather for your fields.

weatherEmptyDescription: Choose your district and Kisaan AI will show the weather for your fields.
advisoryStormBody: Tie up support poles, move animals under cover and delay spraying and fertiliser.
advisoryRainTodayBody: Hold off on watering and spraying. Rain will wash the spray off the leaves.
advisoryRainTomorrowBody: Finish spraying today, or wait until the rain has passed.
advisoryHeatBody: Water early in the morning or after sunset, and check young plants for wilting.
advisoryFrostBody: Frost can damage young plants. Light watering in the evening keeps the soil warmer.
advisoryWindBody: Skip spraying today. Wind carries the spray away from your crop.
advisoryDryBody: A good window for spraying, weeding and harvesting. Keep an eye on soil moisture.
